gates.metric: % of the binary's own Swift symbols recovered
gates.oracle: the binary's own LC_SYMTAB Swift-mangled symbols (a non-circular, in-artifact ground truth); reference parity is swift-demangle
gates.title: Swift mangled-symbol demangle recall vs the binary's own symbol table

gates.metric: % of the planted committed (non-secret) IOC categories detected
gates.oracle: deliberately planted findings (endpoint, manifest, URL, IPv4, email, .onion) committed under corpus/recon/planted - the ground truth

gates.metric: % of committed pickle fixtures fully disassembled + traced + classified
gates.oracle: pickletools-semantics equivalence: every committed fixture must disassemble to a STOP, symbolically execute, and classify (benign vs malicious) correctly
gates.title: pickle corpus disassemble + symbolic-trace + safety-classification coverage

note: These three gates already prove disrobe correct against an external reference or a planted ground truth, but their numbers were not in recovery.json. This bench runs each gate's measurement in-process (the same public API the committed test exercises) and records the number so the evidence report can surface it. A gate whose fixture is sourcing-gated on this box is recorded skipped-with-reason, never a silent pass.
